title: EinfachGustaf-Texturepack
description: 🌊A costum Texturepack, wich change a Part of Minecraft's GUI to a cool blue themed Design.🦈
body:
🌊Gustaf GUI Pack🦈

Bring the world of **Einfach Gustaf** into your Minecraft experience with this custom UI texture pack.

 Overview

The Gustaf UI Pack replaces several vanilla HUD elements with textures inspired by the German Minecraft YouTuber **Einfach Gustaf** and his iconic blue shark-themed design. Every texture has been carefully created to match Gustaf's branding while keeping the familiar Minecraft look and feel.

 Features

🔹 Custom Hearts inspired by Gustaf's style

🔹 Redesigned Hunger Bar with matching blue-themed icons

🔹 Unique Armor Bar textures fitting the shark aesthetic

🔹 Clean and recognizable design that blends naturally with Minecraft

🔹 Perfect for fans of Einfach Gustaf and his content

 Why Download This Pack?

If you enjoy watching Einfach Gustaf on YouTube, this pack lets you bring a piece of his style directly into your game. The custom HUD elements make Minecraft feel more personal while remaining easy to read and visually appealing.

Whether you're exploring, building, or surviving, the Gustaf GUI Pack adds a fun touch inspired by one of Germany's most popular Minecraft creators.

💙 Made for the Gustaf community.
🦈 Designed to match his iconic blue shark skin.
🎮 Lightweight, simple, and easy to use.
